name: nokos-id
description: Nokos.ID V2 - Platform OTP & Wallet Ledger by Angga Official

scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 execute nokos-db --file=migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute nokos-db --file=migrations/0002_indexes.sql && wrangler d1 execute nokos-db --file=migrations/0003_multi_provider.sql && wrangler d1 execute nokos-db --file=migrations/0004_hidden_provider.sql
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute nokos-db --local --file=migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute nokos-db --local --file=migrations/0002_indexes.sql && wrangler d1 execute nokos-db --local --file=migrations/0003_multi_provider.sql && wrangler d1 execute nokos-db --local --file=migrations/0004_hidden_provider.sql
scripts.db:studio: wrangler d1 execute nokos-db --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;"
scripts.kv:create: wrangler kv namespace create RATE_LIMIT && wrangler kv namespace create SESSIONS
